name: workload_vpic_kokkos
description: VPIC-Kokkos (TauferLab/vpic-kokkos devel): CMake args that build a fast Cray/OpenMP build, the traced/untraced flux run command (TLS tunable, --tpp), a sized I/O-enabled short_pulse deck copy, and a build check; plus (v3) the VPIC-Kokkos recipe/check: two-stage deck compile and annotated-install symlinks, bare-identifier REGION macros, Weibel smoke vs production portability_test decks (N*M*K ranks), benchmark.cxx ENABLE_OUTPUT gate, MPI-bound diagnosis and the field_advance_kernels_t segfault. Load for vpic, 'Bad domain decompostion', libsci_cray_mp.so TLS errors.

history.why: Exploration 20261106-095720-67f5a119 built, annotated, traced and ran VPIC-Kokkos by hand; it found several non-obvious fixes (Release needed for -O3, Cray wrappers, install/bin/vpic broken, static TLS tunable, --tpp, deck sizing with I/O on) that no capability owns.

Explorations 20261110-085150-69cc1bfb / 20261111-202500-0de3a1b5 built the write_functions branch with parallel HDF5 and dftracer; add the HDF5 configure arguments (hdf5_root, HDF5_NO_FIND_PACKAGE_CONFIG_FILE, -DVPIC_ENABLE_HDF5) and the run-time HDF5 lib dir, plus corner cases.

merged dftracer-agents skill workload-vpic-kokkos: CPU-only Kokkos build, two-stage deck compile and annotated-install symlinks, annotation macro rules, deck sizing, MPI-bound diagnosis, energy-reduction patches (species half verified, field half reverted: struct growth segfault), benchmark.cxx ENABLE_OUTPUT I/O profile; added workload_vpic_kokkos_recipe (predictor) and workload_vpic_kokkos_check (validator), declared pvc, 8 lessons and WORKED.md.
